title: LP interspace landmarks
view: Lower back from behind, patient in the left lateral decubitus position: spine across the image, head to the right, the upper (right) flank at the top, the bed side at the bottom.
teachingPoint: Join the tops of the iliac crests: Tuffier's line crosses the spine at about L4; go in at L3-L4 or L4-L5, below the conus.
claims: Left lateral decubitus, seen from behind, head to the right (the record's opening-pressure position).
Dashed: Tuffier's line through the highest points of both iliac crests, perpendicular to the spine, crossing at the L4 spinous process (record).
Purple lines: the iliac crests as palpated and marked, from the posterior superior iliac spines to their highest points at the flanks.
Teal: the L3-L4 and L4-L5 interspaces, either side of L4 (record).
Purple dots: spinous processes L2-S1, about 3.8 cm apart (standard adult anatomy); L4 ringed.
Standard anatomy added: the iliac crests rising from the posterior superior iliac spine dimples to their highest point at the flanks, about 14 cm either side of the spine; the midline furrow.
Labels: Iliac crest, Tuffier's line, L4, L3–L4, L4–L5.
